patterns.note: A centered, fixed-width content container provides a consistent reading width, framed by generous whitespace on either side, emphasizing the content within.

The primary branding (artist name) uses a very light-weight, uppercase sans-serif font, creating an elegant and minimal display, contrasted with a more standard, readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.

The site employs a largely monochromatic palette of white, black, and various shades of grey for backgrounds and text, with a single vibrant blue used exclusively for interactive elements like links and buttons.

The header, containing the artist's name and main navigation, remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, allowing the main content, including the hero image, to scroll fluidly underneath it.
Tour dates are presented in a clean, vertically stacked list format, with each entry clearly delineating event details and providing distinct 'Tickets' and 'RSVP' call-to-action buttons.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a fixed-width main content area that is horizontally centered, creating a focused viewing experience with ample negative space. The background remains a clean white.

The header element is implemented as a sticky component, fixing its position to the top of the browser window upon scroll, ensuring navigation and branding are always accessible. The content below scrolls naturally beneath this fixed header.

The hero image incorporates a subtle, ethereal particle or light effect, which appears to be a static visual treatment within the image itself, potentially rendered using WebGL/Three.js for its visual complexity rather than for scroll-triggered animation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin, uppercase display heading (~3x body) with smaller, regular-weight body text and uppercase navigation.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements, including buttons and input fields, feature crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — a clear vertical rhythm is maintained, with airy spacing around the hero and header, transitioning to a more compact but still readable density in the tour date list.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its stark minimalism and centered, fixed-width layout, which evokes a classic, almost editorial feel. This is powerfully contrasted by a single, visually rich and ethereal hero image, creating a unique blend of understated elegance and artistic depth.
